test_access_truth.interpretation: Prior test access is already recorded in live state and A6 results. This follow-up is post-exposure; the historical false field is preserved as history and is not copied as current truth.

data_binding.train_role: The current ESPRIT estimator has no learned coefficients; D1 train group identities bind its speed-specific/mixed scope. The complete D1 validation split selects the shared rank/Hankel configuration.
data_binding.validation_CSI_opened_by_planned_scan: D1 main UMa validation groups only, loaded one at a time after the scan is launched

A3b_validation_scan.algorithm: Existing revision.code.baselines.classical.predictors.ClassicalPredictor._predict_esprit implementation; no canonical code change
A3b_validation_scan.origin_selection: Four unique indices at the first, approximately one-third, approximately two-thirds, and last positions of the complete target-valid D1 validation origin grid for each horizon.
A3b_validation_scan.rank_hankel_grid_rule: For history length L=10 and rows r in 2..9, include every integer rank q from 1 through min(r-1, L-r).
A3b_validation_scan.score: Arithmetic mean of the 24 validation environment x 4 horizon NMSE-dB cells. Each cell sums the same four selected origins, all four users, all eight antennas, and all 32 subcarriers. Persistence fallback rows remain in the score and fallback counts are retained.
A3b_validation_scan.selection_freeze: Write one selected configuration from D1 validation before any D2/D3 challenge predictions; no later challenge result may change it.
A3b_validation_scan.sparse_validation_limit: This is a predeclared 4-origin-per-environment/horizon parameter-selection slice, not a full-grid D1 validation performance estimate.

A6c_challenge_extension.existing_a6_raw_status_note: The raw paired-summary code keyed rows by row.method although the frozen per-environment rows store the method under source.
A6c_challenge_extension.existing_a6_corrected_summary_recomputed: Existing frozen per_environment.source/task_id/environment_id/paired_delta_db rows only; no model or challenge evaluation rerun.
A6c_challenge_extension.pairing_rule: Use the exact existing A6 challenge task definitions, environment IDs, origin/target indices, and paired neural anchor. Emit one ESPRIT result for every expected environment-task cell; never choose/tune configuration on those results.
A6c_challenge_extension.output_custody: New result under this follow-up directory only; do not amend the existing A6 result, summary, source custody, or formal-test seals.
A6c_challenge_extension.full_challenge_start_gate: Implement separate batched CPU adapter; compare prediction, whole-row persistence fallback, first failure reason, and failure counts with the canonical scalar implementation on synthetic edge cases plus preauthorized D1 train histories; measure the adapter before deciding whether a full challenge fits the local budget.

resource_estimate.resource_profile: CPU only, maximum 2 threads, no more than 4 GiB additional RAM

synthetic_baseline_microbenchmark.source: current CPU _esprit_forecast rank=2, rows=5; synthetic exact two-tone sequence only

D2_D3_full_challenge.batched_adapter_target: Minutes to a few hours if numerical equivalence and a measured speedup support a bounded full challenge
